correctness.rationale: The addition theorem and antipodal parity reduce the 20-by-20 Gram matrix to a 10-by-10 matrix. In the explicitly reconstructed dodecahedral coordinates, the unsigned Petersen matrix satisfies C^2=2I-C+J and the signed matrix satisfies B^2=A+3I and B^3=5B; these identities give all eigenvalues and multiplicities. The independent exact-rational script verifies all 186 finite degrees 0..185 and the exceptional rank pattern. A proved Legendre integral inequality bounds 6|P_k(1/3)|+3|P_k(sqrt(5)/3)|<1 for every k>=186; hence every high-degree reduced eigenvalue is strictly positive. The proof handles all k>=0, not just finite tests.

value.rationale: The twenty vertices of the regular dodecahedron are a canonical five-design and concrete spherical sampling grid in published imaging research. The exact-degree evaluation rank is a natural finite-sampling invariant. A complete all-integer-degree classification exhibits nonmonotone rank reversals at degree five, isolated later gaps at eight and fourteen, and permanent full interpolation from exactly fifteen, with the entire Gram spectrum given by three symmetry sectors. This supplies a structural classification and a sharp cutoff, not a routine restatement of the five-design property.
